# SYNESIS_E069 — Error

## Description

Field `field_name` defined more than once in the template.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field 'field_name' is defined more than once in the template.
  Field names must be unique. Remove the duplicate definition or rename
  one of the fields if they represent different information.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **DuplicateFieldName**: `field_name`
